change.purpose: Operator requests 2026-09-25: (1) a better way to save and update saved missions ('SPARADE UPPDRAG' could not be administered; queue sets kept stale mission texts); 21 normalized GFW bootstrap texts to import; (2) the 24-mission limit (GF-054 not saved); (3) fix the hypothetical case where ChatGPT's 'Våra system bearbetar den här förfrågan …' notice could be captured as assistant text.
change.rootCause: saveMissionPreset matched only identical text, so an edited text became a new record with a new id; queue slots and queue sets copied the text at add/save and never resolved savedMissionId; a parked slot resumed with its process snapshot's text; the bookmark vault kept the 24 newest by updatedAt and silently removed the rest (panel save: the oldest mission disappeared; a record written with an older updatedAt was removed in the same write and failed with SAVED_MISSION_VAULT_COMMIT_READBACK_MISMATCH - both reproduced against the v1.8.4 vault code); save errors were written to the shared status line, which every render overwrites.
change.fix: lib/saved-mission-catalog.mjs: identity = first-line GFW key; Markdown (### GF-xxx) / JSON import parser with all-or-nothing errors; import plan (create/update/unchanged, duplicate merge, limit); reference resolution (id, merged id, stale id re-linked by key to exactly one record; slots without savedMissionId never touched); export; cleanup rows. operator-settings: saveSavedMission AUTO/UPDATE/CREATE (same key updates in place, key conflicts refused), applySavedMissionImport with durable readback, limit 64. Vault: capacity refusal before any write, pruning removed. Queue sets: reconcileMissionQueueSetsWithSavedMissions rewrites stored sets (store + vault, readback). Background: current text at ADD, set SAVE/UPDATE/APPLY and slot activation (parked included; bootstrap text only; SAVED_MISSION_BOOTSTRAP_REFRESHED audited); EIC_GF_SAVED_MISSIONS_CHANGED reconciles sets and this window's queue. Panel: admin card (edit, save change, save as new, confirmed delete, import preview/apply, export, cleanup), N/64 counter with full state, own save status line. content.js: the processing notice is status for assistant turns (structural removal + line filter).
change.runtimeChange: saved-mission identity/limit/propagation; activation uses the saved mission's current text; content capture ignores the processing notice
